title: Document magic constants STATUS_MAX_BYTES and WHOIS_MAX_BYTES with security rationale
description:
Lines 62 and 65 define:
  const STATUS_MAX_BYTES: usize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
  const WHOIS_MAX_BYTES: usize = 102_400;

Current comments only say WHAT they limit, not WHY those specific values.

RISK: A maintainer might lower/raise these without understanding consequences (DoS, memory exhaustion).

ISSUE: Without documented rationale, a future maintainer will guess.

SUGGESTION: Add rationale comments explaining observed tailnet sizes or Tailscale API evolution expectations.
